title: Limit of the finite degree factors
statement: For every natural number $k$, the sequence $\bigl((1+1/m)^{m+1}\bigr)^{2k}$, indexed by natural numbers $m$, converges to $e^{2k}$ as $m$ tends to infinity.
replaced: For every integer $k\ge0$, the sequence $((1+1/m)^{m+1})^{2k}$ converges to $e^{2k}$ as the positive integer $m\to\infty$.
